title: Direct Attenuation Correction Using Deep Learning for Cardiac SPECT: A Feasibility Study.
summary: direct DCNN maps non-corrected SPECT images to CT-attenuation-corrected appearance on 100 retrospective cardiac SPECT datasets. Quantitative agreement/artifact reduction are promising, but no reader study or clinical interpretation was performed.
